name: Balls V1 Total V2
author: AAidalol
description: A remake of the level 'Balls V1 Total' that was intentionally named to be very confusing. Also the first level Aida played on her pointer finger in a while, which made her tendonitis flare up much worse. The name implies that it is the second version of the first version, hence v1... v2. Has a possible 240 FPS frame perfect first ship click. Hardest part is 0-25.
